title: SY AirPlay
description: SY AirPlay - your iPhone's screen on the central display by AirPlay screen mirroring, in this experimental build also while driving. Needs the sy-airplay-d tool.

id8.description: SY AirPlay - your iPhone's screen on the iDrive 8 display by AirPlay screen mirroring, in this experimental build also while driving: disconnect CarPlay, join the car's Wi-Fi, then Screen Mirroring and the car's name. The sound stays on Bluetooth. Needs the sy-airplay-d tool and the GPU renderer (mgu-render).
